levels.description:
<$ba.steal>Steals</> <@ba.vup>{steal}</> ASPD from <@ba.vup>1</> allied Operator within Attack Range (lasts until skill ends or Exusiai the New Covenant leaves the field), and both this unit and the targeted Operator gain a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{shield_max_hp_ratio:0%}</> Max HP which decays; Attack Interval reduces, each attack deals <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill); if ASPD is successfully <$ba.steal>Stolen</>, grants an additional 5 ammo</>
